Read the methods to check participant scope and the reliance on practitioner accounts.
Direct experience report involving novices and mixed-experience teams; useful context but insufficient to establish a population success rate.

evidence_items.explanation: The review synthesizes 101 practitioner sources and reports a speed–quality trade-off. Its mixed population, self-selected accounts, and insufficiently precise observation dates prevent treating it as a quarter-specific measurement of how few amateurs can harden applications.

The report describes functional demonstrations and quality problems among 31 participants in nine teams. It does not establish the event within the target quarter or measure subsequent production-hardening success; the authors expressly decline generalizability.
